item.title: Repeated Completion Without Output & Unnecessary Credit Consumption
item.body:
Hello,

I would like to report a recurring issue I’ve been experiencing with Trae.

Quite frequently, after very long processing times, the system returns a “complete” status but provides no actual output. This results in wasted time and unnecessary credit consumption. I have already submitted a bug report through Trae itself, but unfortunately this issue continues to happen on a weekly basis.

This is becoming increasingly disruptive to my workflow. At the very least, it would be extremely helpful if the system could check for service instability or known issues before allowing users to start a session. That way, we wouldn’t lose both time and credits when the system is not operating properly.

I’d appreciate clarification on:

Whether this is a known issue

If there is a fix or workaround available

Whether credits can be refunded in such cases

If a system status check can be implemented before session start

Please let me know how this will be addressed.

Thank you,
Ulas
ulascakir@gmail.com
